title: Smartsheet API introduction
snippet:
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
**Developer Agreement:** The [Developer Agreement](https://www.smartsheet.com/legal/developer-program-agreement) governs the use of the Smartsheet API and Smartsheet software development kits (SDKs)

title: Get Started
snippet:
## Generate an API access token
**Required plan:** Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management
Generate an API access token in the Smartsheet UI.
1. Go to the Smartsheet UI.
2. Select your **Account** icon in the lower-left corner of the screen, and then select **Personal Settings**. The Personal Settings page for your account appears.
3. Select the **API Access** tab.
4. Click the **Generate new access token** button to generate an API access token.
![](https://developers.smartsheet.com/assets/generate-api-token.88baa369e3a9a493b9b77c98f575bdedf4f5122f5a96b85e4414f44817635503.99ff9e22.png)
5. Note your access token and store it in a secure location. See [Access Token Best Practices](https://developers.smartsheet.com/api/smartsheet/guides/basics/authentication#access-token-best-practices).
> **Note:** Tokens generated for Smartsheet, Smartsheet Regions instances, and Smartsheet Gov use the above generation process.
>
> However, these tokens aren't interchangeable.
>
> - A token generated on Smartsheet doesn't work on a Smartsheet Regions instance or Smartsheet Gov.
> - Each environment requires a token specifically generated for it.

title: Smartsheet
snippet:
**Authentication:** A Smartsheet API access token. Serval stores the token securely and sends it as a bearer token only to the Smartsheet API host for the region you select (United States, European Union, or Australia). Smartsheet Gov is not supported.

API access requires a Smartsheet Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management plan.
##
​
Create an API access token
Workflows act as the Smartsheet user who owns the token. We recommend a dedicated service-account user, shared into every sheet your workflows use, with **Editor** access or higher on sheets where workflows make changes.
1
Sign in as the service user
Sign in to Smartsheet as the user Serval will act as.
2
Open API access
Select your profile image at the bottom of the left navigation, choose **Personal Settings**, and open the **API Access** tab.
3
Generate the token
Select **Generate new access token**, name it Serval, and copy the token. Smartsheet shows it only once.

1
Name the connection
Enter a recognizable instance name, such as Production.
2
Select the region
Choose United States, European Union, or Australia. Accounts that sign in at app.smartsheet.eu are in the EU region, and accounts that sign in at app.smartsheet.au are in the Australia region.
3
Enter the token
Paste the API access token and submit the form.

A failed check usually means the token is invalid or revoked, the wrong region was selected, or the account’s plan does not include API access.

Smartsheet allows 300 API requests per minute per token and rejects concurrent writes to the same sheet. Serval waits and retries when either limit is hit.
